notes.title: Treehouse Riddle Demo Now Playable
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35826661/aabae5290682d3e03fa1401c4567fe277ca59fff.jpg[/img]
Take your time in the charming treehouse. Solve puzzles, but don't hesitate to use the hint system if you get stuck. 

The demo is expected to take 30-60 minutes if you solve every puzzle. 

What is the story behind the treehouse...?
